text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
1st place in the Arima Kinen goes to 
Tamamo Cross. Despite her defeat, Yaeno 
Muteki still felt confident in her own 
running performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd erupted over the fierce battle 
between Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. And 
they praised Oguri Cap for her valiant 
effort, calling her the representative of 
their generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No one spoke the name of Yaeno Muteki. No 
one talked about the fierce battle of the 
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That angered Yaeno Muteki. She believed 
that the true representatives of their 
generation were those who had fought 
through the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, she would defeat Oguri Cap and prove 
that their generation carries the future. 
That was the "obsession" Yaeno Muteki 
displayed.
